_comment: ONE SIP — till-only venue (owner's aunt; LumiPOS provided free). NO customer website, NO online ordering, NO Stripe: both fulfillment modes are disabled (order page + /api/order refuse), card is taken on her own machine (pos.externalCardMachine). The Pages project exists only to serve /staff to her Windows till at the *.pages.dev URL. Menu transcribed from her old Epos Now till (account name 'Nazli') 2026-07-16. Went live on Cloudflare 2026-07-18 (project: one-sip, v2 build system). TODO before receipts go out: confirm address, phone, legal name and opening hours with the owner.

business._comment_shortName: Conversational short form used in page headers, aria labels and the staff PWA name (e.g. 'Pizza Bob's' instead of 'Pizza Bob's Burgers Ltd').

_comment_theme: Brand colours. Defaults match Rico's red palette — change these to match the shop's branding.

fulfillment._comment: Till-only: no online ordering at all. Both modes off — /api/order rejects and the order page shows the 'come see us in store' banner.

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order platform fee in pence. Charged to the customer and kept by the platform.
_comment_stripe: Stripe Connect: this site's PaymentIntents are created on the venue's connected account. connectedAccountId is the venue's acct_xxx string from Stripe Connect.

hours._comment: TODO — placeholder café hours (Mon-Sun 08:00-16:00). Confirm with the owner; drives the Z-report trading day.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: Trading-day rollover hour (0–23, shop local time). 4 = the day's orders / takings / Z-report run 4am-to-4am, so a late-night shop's orders taken after midnight still count toward the day it opened. Set 0 for a plain midnight-to-midnight day. Safe to leave at 4 even for daytime shops (if you close before midnight there's nothing in the 0–4am window to reclassify).

_comment_promo: Optional online discounts, both disabled by default — enable ONLY the one this shop actually runs. (1) autoOnlineDiscount: `percent`% off EVERY online order's subtotal, for everyone; shows in the cart, the SEO meta description and the terms page. (2) firstOrders: a signed-in customer gets `percent`% off their first `limit` orders — a welcome offer that rewards sign-ups. It's enforced server-side against the account (guests never qualify), only spends a redemption once the order is actually placed/paid, and takes precedence over autoOnlineDiscount (they don't stack). A matching banner shows on the landing page when it's on.
_comment_pos: Till behaviour flags (all optional, default off). requireOrderPin:true makes staff enter their operator code to START every order (walk-in/collection/delivery) — leave it false so staff take orders with no per-order PIN. NOTE: the manager/owner PIN on voids, refunds and cancellations is a SEPARATE gate and is ALWAYS required regardless of this flag. selfServeDrinks:true hides the till's drink picker; externalCardMachine:true marks the Card button as paid immediately for a shop using its own card terminal.

payments._comment_cvcThreshold: Order total (in pence) above which a customer paying with a saved card has to re-enter their CVV. Defends against account-takeover for higher-value orders. Set to 0 to never require CVC re-collection. £50 = 5000.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the restaurant before ordering.
